app.name: Rustle
app.heroBody: A focused workspace for communities that move between Amharic and English all day.
app.featureRealtimeBody: Messages travel over a binary WebSocket gateway in milliseconds.
app.featureBilingualBody: Every label, menu and empty state is translated, never machine-stubbed.
app.featurePresenceBody: Online, idle, do not disturb and automatic offline detection.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to pick up where your workspace left off.
auth.signUpSubtitle: Start a private workspace in less than a minute.
auth.loginFailed: We could not sign you in. Check your email and password.
auth.registerFailed: We could not create that account. Try a different email.
auth.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists.

chat.emptyBody: Send the first message. It will be stored in ScyllaDB and fanned out over NATS.
chat.failedHint: The gateway did not acknowledge this message.
chat.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
chat.recordHint: Record up to two minutes. The clip is uploaded and attached to your message.
chat.editHint: Enter to save · Esc to cancel

guild.createBody: Servers are shared spaces for your community. You can invite people after creating one.
guild.name: Server name
guild.inviteBody: Add someone who already has a Rustle account.
guild.billingBody: This local deployment stores billing configuration in PostgreSQL. No payment processor is connected.
guild.managerOnly: Only server owners and admins can invite people or change billing.
guild.membersBody: Assign roles to control who can manage channels, invites and members.

channel.createBody: Channels keep conversations grouped. Names are normalized to lowercase with dashes.
channel.name: Channel name
channel.voiceUnavailable: Join this voice channel to start a peer-to-peer call.

connection.offline: You are offline. Messages will fail until the gateway reconnects.
connection.slow: Your connection is falling behind. Reconnecting.
connection.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.

errors.loadWorkspace: We could not load your workspace.
errors.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: The server is unreachable. Check that Docker Compose is running.
errors.notAllowed: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.seatLimit: No seats remain on this plan.
errors.userNotFound: No registered account uses that email.
errors.alreadyMember: That person is already in this server.
errors.channelExists: A channel with that name already exists.
errors.crashBody: The interface hit an unexpected error. Reloading usually fixes it.
errors.PROFILE_IMAGE_ONLY: Choose a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.
errors.UPLOAD_FAILED: Upload failed. Try a smaller file.
errors.CAMERA_UNAVAILABLE: The camera is unavailable. Joining with audio only.
errors.CALL_OFFLINE: Connect to the gateway before joining a call.
errors.CALL_PERMISSION_DENIED: Microphone or camera permission was denied.
errors.CALL_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND: No microphone or camera was found.
errors.CALL_DEVICE_BUSY: The microphone or camera is already in use.
errors.CALL_TIMEOUT: The call did not connect. Try again.
errors.CALL_CONNECTION_FAILED: A call peer could not connect. A TURN server may be required on this network.
errors.SESSION_REFRESH: The session refreshed. Reconnect to continue.
errors.CALL_FULL: This call is full (8 participants maximum).
errors.CALL_UNAVAILABLE: The call could not be joined. Try again.

profile.settingsSubtitle: Make this space feel like yours.
profile.bioPlaceholder: Tell your community a little about yourself.
profile.accountBody: Your email is used to sign in and is never shown to other members.
profile.appearanceBody: Choose how Rustle looks on this device.
profile.theme_light: Warm paper surfaces with a dark espresso rail.
profile.theme_dark: Deep brown surfaces for low-light rooms.
profile.sampleMessage: This is how a message looks.
profile.languageBody: Choose the language for every label and menu.
profile.languageHint: Amharic and English are both fully translated. Your choice is saved on this device and synced to your profile when you save.
profile.voiceBody: Check your microphone and camera before joining a call. Your browser asks for permission the first time.
profile.voiceHint: Calls use peer-to-peer WebRTC. A STUN server is configured by default; a TURN server is required for reliable calls across restrictive networks.
profile.statusBody: Set a custom status and quiet hours. Quiet hours pause notifications for your mentions digest.
profile.quietHoursHint: While quiet hours are on, the catch-up digest still collects mentions but stays silent.

call.lobbyBody: Join the voice channel to talk, share your camera, or share your screen with everyone here.
call.lobbyHint: Your microphone is muted until you unmute. You can change that any time in the call controls.
call.waiting: You are the first one here. Invite someone to join.

pins.title: Pinned in #{{channel}}
pins.body: Messages people wanted to keep close at hand in this channel.
pins.empty: Nothing is pinned here yet. Use a message menu to pin one.

saved.title: Saved messages
saved.body: Your personal bookmarks, synced across every device you sign in from.
saved.empty: You have not saved any messages yet.

digest.title: Catch-up digest
digest.body: Everything you missed, grouped by channel and ordered by newest activity.
digest.empty: You are all caught up. Nothing unread right now.

invite.title: Invites
invite.body: Create shareable links or join a server with a code you were given.
invite.joinPlaceholder: Paste an invite link or code
invite.invalid: That invite is invalid, expired or fully used.
invite.none: No active invites for this server.

permissions.title: Permissions · #{{channel}}
permissions.body: Decide which roles can see and post in this channel.
permissions.hint: Members must be able to view a channel before they can send in it. Owners always retain access.
